messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete playable 3D storytelling survival game about leaving Earth, with a HUD players can use.

## Requirements
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks, viewport at most 1280px wide.

## Decisions
- Created “AFTERLIGHT,” a first-person survival story set on the alien moon Erebus-7.
- Gameplay objective: search the crash site, gather supplies and three signal cells, reach and activate the rescue beacon.
- Added desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls.

## Work State

content.text:
Built **AFTERLIGHT**, a playable first-person survival story set on the alien moon Erebus-7. Search the crash site, manage suit systems, collect three signal cells, and activate the rescue beacon.

**Controls:** WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact, 1 for a medkit, 2 for a thermal flare, and Esc to pause. Mobile touch controls are included.

I checked the game in-browser and saved a gameplay screenshot at `screenshots/afterlight-final.jpg`. Assumption: “leave Earth” meant a stranded-on-an-alien-world survival scenario.
